R0162.title: Private Key Leakage and Management Risks
R0162.definition: Blockchain wallet private keys being stolen, leaked, or improperly managed, leading to digital asset theft.
R0162.description: Private keys are the sole credential for controlling blockchain assets; once leaked, the action is irreversible. Attackers can obtain private keys through phishing, malware, social engineering, or insecure storage. Additionally, seed phrase leakage, improper multi-signature threshold settings, or insufficient key generation randomness can also create asset risks.
R0162.influence: User digital assets are stolen and cannot be recovered; platform custodial assets face security threats.

observables: Wallet private keys or seed phrases appear in phishing site inputs, malware exfiltration, or clipboard hijacking records
Wallet assets are entirely transferred to unfamiliar addresses shortly after a private key leak, then routed into a mixer
The signer threshold of a multi-signature wallet is set too low, allowing a single private key leak to trigger asset transfers
The randomness source used for key generation is of insufficient quality, with multiple wallet private keys showing predictable correlations
